html5: Welcome to Mars! You are in charge of a base with {crew} astronauts. Your goal: keep your crew safe and the base running for
html7: . A sol is one day on Mars.
html8: Look after oxygen, water, radiation shielding, energy and food. Each sol brings one or two cards. Choose what to do, then see how your choice changes the base.
html10: Or swipe left or right to begin.
html16: The crew stops here. You can start a new mission after.

difficultyHardHint: Start with half your supplies. Physical units and harder cards.

failedBody-life-support: Life Support ran out. Your crew needs both oxygen to breathe and water to drink. The mission must stop.
failedBody-oxygen: The oxygen supply ran out. Your crew needs oxygen to breathe. The mission must stop.
failedBody-water: The water supply ran out. Your crew needs water to drink and run the base. The mission must stop.
failedBody-shield: The shelter has no radiation shielding left. Your crew cannot stay safely. The mission must stop.
failedBody-energy: The energy supply ran out. The base cannot keep its machines running. The mission must stop.
failedBody-food: The food supply ran out. Your crew needs food to keep going. The mission must stop.
dailyCostHint: Choose one resource to use {dailyCostMultiplier}× faster. Production stays the same. Shield has no daily use.

tutorialCardBody: Each choice has a trade-off: it can help one supply but use another. Tap a choice, or swipe left or right.
tutorialEffectsBody: Lasting effects and planned changes appear here. Hover or tap an icon to see its changes per sol, or when it happens.
